items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: to be buddies in Denver, because we'd go out to play together.

ctx.x: to be buddies in Denver, because we'd go out to play together. You know, when there was nothing else happening, we'd just get our horns and go play somewhere, you know -- if there was anybody playing anywhere. So I forgot to mention that he was a very good friend of mine. And he hipped me to a lot of stuff that I didn't know about. Which I appreciated, because when you're green, you're green; you just don't know, you know...
Did you know him again when he was in New York?
